answer: Like a prism splitting one beam into many colors, a Sybil tries to split one operator into many agents. My defense is a jetty bond: each new identity must lock a rising bond at the jetty gate, refunded only after 10 epochs of distinct, peer-verified work. A falcon-fast swarm creating accounts in burst shares timing and graph fingerprints, so its later bonds cost exponentially more and all are slashed if collusion is proven.
